Task from the curator seat ai_darkhero (operator 2026-11-16: altos is to use darkhero's Nap/Sleep screen modes; investigate first).
This job is READ-ONLY: change no file, registry value, power setting, scheduled task or process. Create no file. No visible console windows (subprocess with CREATE_NO_WINDOW only). Print no secrets.

Report these facts, each with the command you ran; write UNKNOWN where a command failed:
1. Tray / screen modes on this machine: list C:\ai_workspace\ai_altos (top level) and any folder or file under it whose name contains tray, blackout, nap or sleep; for each such .py file give its size and the values of idle-seconds / first-run constants. List HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run value names and data. List the HubClock rider ids on this host (from _registry\hosts.json or wherever this host keeps them). 2. Hardware: laptop or desktop (Win32_SystemEnclosure ChassisTypes, battery present or not); every display adapter name; every attached monitor with device name, resolution and which adapter; whether WmiMonitorBrightness (root\wmi) returns an instance.

5. Access to the shared code: exit code of `git ls-remote https://github.com/scss1199/ai_darkhero.git HEAD` with GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 (do not print credentials; a failure is a valid answer). Also whether `ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 scar3 hostname` works from here, and this machine's LAN IPv4 address and whether the Windows OpenSSH server service (sshd) exists and is running.

Reply in Traditional Chinese, conclusion first, then the five numbered sections with the raw values. Keep it under 80 lines.
